title: Bilateral grip-trial synchrony fails an incremental depressive-symptom prediction test
abstract: Bilateral grip-curvature synchrony did not establish incremental prediction of PHQ-9 symptom burden across NHANES2011–2012 and2013–2014: weighted MSE gain 0.00002502 score² (0.00015%), two-sample PSU pipeline-refit95% interval [-0.070107,0.034786]. Fixed source-only ridge models transferred from4196 to4687 complete-case adults. This is a narrow negative model comparison, not equivalence, diagnosis, or evidence that all motor variability is uninformative.

citations.reason: Smith et al. Depressive symptoms, handgrip strength, and weight status in US older adults. J Affect Disord238:305–310(2018), doi10.1016/j.jad.2018.06.016. Primary motivation for a strength-adjusted symptom prediction question, not evidence for synchrony.
